notes.title: Mouse Support Added!
notes.notes:
ANOIX has been updated, since now you can use the mouse to play. Just pick it from the menu.

Now you have 3 ways to play:
[list]
[*]Keyboard
[*]Mouse
[*]Gamepad (analog stick)
[/list]

notes.title: Lots of new players in ANOIX
notes.notes: You appreciate the uniqueness of ANOIX, deep, hypnotising experience. Welcome.

notes.title: Achievements have been added!
notes.notes: Great news for all ANOIX players. Achievements have been added to the game. They are quite challenging to get, try to achieve them all!

notes.title: Thank you for playing!
notes.notes:
Five hours since the release and we already have a lot of players!

We hope you like the gameplay!

notes.title: ANOIX has been released!
notes.notes: We are so excited to announce the ANOIX release! Will the world love the game? We are about to see.
